# Wordcraft document samples

These DOCX files were exported from the official Wordcraft v0.12.0 portable browser
build using its built-in Open Studio Handbook sample. The design variant applies
Studio fonts and colors, heading rules and a DRAFT text watermark through the
application's Design controls.

Source: https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft

The included MIT license covers the sample content. The fixtures exercise imported
named styles, conditional table formatting, header/footer fields and watermarks.
